superseded.reason: Not released: fresh_clone_verify failed. In a fresh clone, npm run verify stopped at test:tool-service because pytest could not create its temporary directory under .tool-state/ (the folder does not exist yet; CI never saw it because its Tier 1 step creates the folder first). Fixed in package.json (mkdir -p .tool-state, as the other test scripts do); with the fix the full verify passed in the same fresh clone before a new candidate was cut. The checks that passed here (Tier 2 live gate PASS, offline reproduction, README fresh check, demo rebuild, links, CI) were rerun on the new candidate.
